title: Page query with 'select distinct new Dto(coalesce(...))' fails count-query validation: declare the count query on the entity
errorSample:
Caused by: org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryCreationException: Cannot create query for method [MemberRepository.findDisplayNames(org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable)]; Count query validation failed for 'select count(distinct coalescenickname, name) from Member where active = true'
	at org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryCreationException.create(QueryCreationException.java:139) ~[spring-data-commons-4.0.7.jar:4.0.7]
Caused by: org.hibernate.query.SemanticException: Could not interpret path expression 'coalescenickname'
	at org.hibernate.query.hql.internal.BasicDotIdentifierConsumer$BaseLocalSequencePart.resolveTerminal(BasicDotIdentifierConsumer.java:180) ~[hibernate-core-7.2.24.Final.jar:7.2.24.Final]
	at org.hibernate.query.hql.internal.BasicDotIdentifierConsumer$BaseLocalSequencePart.resolvePathPart(BasicDotIdentifierConsumer.java:153) ~[hibernate-core-7.2.24.Final.jar:7.2.24.Final]

	at org.hibernate.query.hql.internal.SemanticQueryBuilder.visitSimplePath(SemanticQueryBuilder.java:5786) ~[hibernate-core-7.2.24.Final.jar:7.2.24.Final]
	at org.hibernate.query.hql.internal.SemanticQueryBuilder.visitGeneralPathFragment(SemanticQueryBuilder.java:5651) ~[hibernate-core-7.2.24.Final.jar:7.2.24.Final]
	at org.hibernate.query.hql.internal.SemanticQueryBuilder.visitGeneralPathExpression(SemanticQueryBuilder.java:1821) ~[hibernate-core-7.2.24.Final.jar:7.2.24.Final]
	at org.hibernate.grammars.hql.HqlParser$GeneralPathExpressionContext.accept(HqlParser.java:7847) ~[hibernate-core-7.2.24.Final.jar:7.2.24.Final]
	at org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.AbstractParseTreeVisitor.visitChildren(AbstractParseTreeVisitor.java:46) ~[antlr4-runtime-4.13.2.jar:4.13.2]
	at org.hibernate.grammars.hql.HqlParserBaseVisitor.visitBarePrimaryExpression(HqlParserBaseVisitor.java:761) ~[hibernate-core-7.2.24.Final.jar:7.2.24.Final]
symptom: Repository creation fails with 'Count query validation failed for select count(distinct coalescenickname, name) from Member where active = true' for a Page-returning @Query that builds a DTO with coalesce(nickname, name).
cause: Spring Data cannot derive a count query from a constructor expression that contains a function call, so the generated count statement is invalid and fails the startup validation of the repository method.
fixSummary: Supply the count query explicitly on the annotation and count the entities that the page is drawn from: countQuery = "select count(m) from Member m where m.active = true". Validation then passes because the count statement is well-formed, and the page total is computed from it.
